description: My mother is 58, diagnosed with HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer that has spread to her liver. She's been on trastuzumab and taxane chemo. ER-negative. She lives near White Plains, NY and is still active and independent.

expect.note: shouldSurface asserts a MODERN HER2-targeted option surfaces for 2nd-line HER2+ MBC — a T-DXd-class ADC or a tucatinib-based regimen. An earlier broad 'any HER2-directed' group was dropped as near-tautological (a HER2 condition search always returns HER2 trials); the point is to catch a collapse of the modern options specifically. Both groups hit on 2026-07-14 (T-DXd: NCT07137416; tucatinib: NCT05748834). minSurface 1 keeps a churn margin; a reviewing clinician can raise it to 2.

description: I'm a 64-year-old man with stage IV non-small cell lung cancer, EGFR exon 19 deletion. Osimertinib stopped working after 18 months. No brain metastases as of my last scan. I live in Stamford, Connecticut.

expect.note: Post-osimertinib EGFR space is trial-dense (amivantamab, 4th-gen/high-dose TKIs, HER3/TROP2 ADCs). shouldSurface asserts a resistance-setting targeted agent OR a relevant ADC appears — bare 'egfr'/'osimertinib' tokens were removed as tautological for an EGFR condition search. Both groups hit on 2026-07-14 (furmonertinib: NCT06652048; dato-dxd: NCT07535437). minSurface 1 for churn margin. Ties to F-016: rich clinician input currently collapses recall here — once fixed, raise minSurface to guard it.
